title: Weakly Supervised Segmentation of Cracks on Solar Cells using Normalized Lp Norm
mechanism: Train a classifier with normalized-Lp pooling over activation maps so the maps become crack segmentations from image-level labels only.
adaptation: Add an image-level crack head (Lp-pooled crack logits) to the house model, trained on the 2,624 ELPV cells, the same source as our weak BMRK cells, after removing every ELPV cell present in BMRK val/test.
min_experiment: Arm: house + Lp image-level loss on ELPV. Baseline: house, 5 seeds. Metric: BMRK crack IoU (0.379 now) and overall crack IoU. Kill if BMRK crack IoU < +0.03.
evidence: R: abstract only; ResNet-50 activation-map segmentation of cracks from ELPV-type image labels; no number retrieved.
prior_overlap: none; multi-dataset training with ELPV image labels listed as untried

alt_notes.adaptation: EL-specific image-label baseline trained on ELPV labels for a weak-supervision track of the benchmark.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Benchmark only: train on ELPV image labels, score crack relF1@2 on clean-49 and E1 against house model. ~2 GPU-h.
